uncited: This method allocates and initializes the `BinningState` structure required for parallel processing and performs a radix sort on point list keys to reorder associated data.
It is a specialized orchestration step within GPU-based volume rendering pipelines that relies on [Radix Sort (GPU)](10404-radix-sort-gpu.md) to manage point cloud data ordering.

Unlike general-purpose sorting, this method is tightly coupled with the memory layout of binning states, ensuring that keys and their corresponding indices are sorted in tandem for efficient subsequent rendering passes.
The method operates on a `BinningState` structure that manages device memory for point list sorting.
It utilizes a radix sort algorithm to sort pairs of keys and indices.
The `BinningState` is a struct containing pointers to device memory.
